###  Loading the necessary information
We first need to,

  - Obtain data from data_all.csv
  - Obtain sample names and their corresponding treatment groups from sample_annotation.csv
  - Obtain gene numbers and their corresponding type and long name from gene_annotation.csv
  - Obtain a list of gene to analyse from genelist_sxxxxxxx.txt

executed from the code below.
If required files to not exist in files folder, execution will stop with an error message.
The data from the files will be imported into R as data frames.

```{r load_info, include=TRUE}

if(file.exists("files/data_all.csv")){
  data_all <- read.csv(file="files/data_all.csv")
}else{
  stop("File data_all.csv not found in the files folder. Please check the working directory and prepare necessary folders and files.")
}

if(file.exists("files/sample_annotation.csv")){
  sample_annotation <- read.csv(file="files/sample_annotation.csv")
}else{
    stop("File sample_annotation.csv not found in the files folder. Please check the working directory and prepare necessary folders and files.")
}

if(file.exists("files/gene_annotation.csv")){
  gene_annotation <- read.csv(file="files/gene_annotation.csv")
}else{
    stop("File gene_annotation.csv not found in the files folder. Please check the working directory and prepare necessary folders and files.")
}

if(file.exists("files/genelist_s3037538.txt")){
  genelist <- read.delim(file="files/genelist_s3037538.txt")
}else{
    stop("File genelist_s3037538.txt not found in the files folder. Please check the working directory and prepare necessary folders and files.")
}
```
